Part 1 高频 事件 EVENTS

Life stages

人生阶段

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1What did you often do with your friends in your childhood?

As a kid, I often played tag and hide-and-seek with my friends after school. We'd run around the neighbourhood until it got dark, and sometimes we'd gather at someone's home to play computer games together.

小时候放学常和朋友玩抓人、捉迷藏，跑遍小区到天黑，有时去别人家打电脑游戏。

Q2What do you think is the most important at the moment?

For me, building solid programming fundamentals is the most important thing right now. I mean, data structures and algorithms come up everywhere in computer science, so getting those right early makes everything else easier.

眼下最重要的是打好编程基础，数据结构算法到处都用得到，基础好别的都顺。

Q3Do you have any plans for the next five years?

Yeah, I do. I plan to finish my degree first, and then work as a software engineer, probably focusing on AI. I've been talking to AI a lot lately, and that's the direction that genuinely excites me.

打算先读完学位，再当软件工程师，方向偏AI，最近常和AI交流，很感兴趣。

Q4How do people remember each stage of their lives?

I think people remember each stage through the impactful moments, the ones tied to strong feelings or big events. I mean, I remember the emotional highlights of my childhood clearly, but the ordinary days have mostly faded away.

人们靠那些印象深刻的时刻记住每个阶段，和强烈情感或大事绑在一起；平淡的日子都淡忘了。

Q5Do you enjoy being the age you are now?

Yeah, I really do. I'm at an age where I can learn, explore and make mistakes without too much pressure. Honestly, being a student gives me the freedom to try new things, which I'm enjoying while it lasts.

挺享受现在的年纪，能学习、探索、试错压力不大，当学生自由尝试新事物。

Q6At what age do you think people are the happiest?

I'd say childhood, definitely. When you're a kid, you don't really have worries, and every day is about playing and having fun. Looking back, those carefree years were probably the happiest of my life.

童年最幸福，小孩没什么烦恼，每天就是玩，回头看那些无忧无虑的日子最快乐。
